results.content: Trump, and Evans’ fidelity to the president, are recognized as a major albatross here. The president is particularly disliked in Colorado. Civiqs found approval of Trump’s job performance at 31%, with disapproval at 64% on July 30.

Race: Black or African-American voters had the highest unfavorable opinion of Trump, with 88% disapproving, followed by Hispanic/Latino at 72% disapproval, Other at 68% disapproval and white at 59% disapproval.

results.title: A new low for Trump approval rating triggered by ongoing war with Iran

results.content: Civiqs, a nonpartisan online polling firm that surveys presidential approval on a rolling basis, puts Trump's current approval in Idaho at 49 percent, with 41 percent disapproving as of Thursday. That figure has fluctuated near that line in recent weeks. The Idaho Democratic Party cited the same Civiqs data in a statement released Aug. 19. [...] Among racial groups, white Idahoans, who make up the large majority of the state's population, approve at 51 percent and disapprove at 40 percent. Black Idahoans approve at 33 percent and disapprove at 67 percent. Hispanic and Latino residents approve at 45 percent and disapprove at 51 percent. Those identifying as another race approve at 44 percent
